Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Karan - 28 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Pallavi - 26 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Shalini - 64 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Neeta - 26 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
5. Nitin - 28 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Karan stands on the training ground. Pallavi and Shalini stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Karan, what's the plan today?"

[Karan practises sword fighting.]

Karan (laughing): "Pallavi, look at this."

[Karan draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Karan (gently): "And then?"

[Karan mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Karan: "That's easy."

[Karan swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Karan (happily): "What happened?"

[Karan shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Karan (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Pallavi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Pallavi: "Mother, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Pallavi stands on the terrace. Neeta stands near her.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Pallavi hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Neeta (excited): "That was such a fun day!"
